messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D One-room Zelda dungeon with a key and a boss.”

## Requirements
- Don’t ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Verify with screenshots saved as small JPEGs (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML canvas game with original art and keyboard/touch controls.
- Dungeon loop: defeat two slimes, collect the revealed key, fight the Warden during recovery windows, then exit through the top doorway.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, responsive styling, canvas gameplay, sprites, dungeon scenery, HUD, title/pause/win/lose screens, and mobile touch controls.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully.
- Served locally and checked desktop and mobile screenshots.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally address any gameplay or visual issues found in a further review.
2. Mention assumptions briefly when reporting completion.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page and canvas.
- `style.css`: Layout, theme, and responsive touch controls.
- `game.js`: Game logic, rendering, input, enemies, and boss.
- `favicon.svg`: Small themed favicon.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local browser checks were performed at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshots were saved under `screenshots/title.jpg`, `screenshots/game.jpg`, and `screenshots/mobile.jpg`.
